size_scope: Grade 5 bolts: nominal 3/8 or 1/2 inch, within the quarter-through-one-inch band. A574: nominal 3/8 inch, within the at-most-half-inch full-size band. Standard hex UNC J995 nuts only; no jam/slotted/heavy-nut substitution.

primary_sources.locator: J429 full-size Grade 5, quarter through one inch
primary_sources.fact: 85 ksi proof stress is distinct from 92 ksi tensile yield and 120 ksi tensile strength.

primary_sources.authority: Baden Steelbar and Bolt manufacturer technical table
primary_sources.locator: Mechanical properties, full-size screws, diameter at most 0.500 inch
primary_sources.fact: Full-size proof stress is 140 ksi. Machined-specimen yield is a separate property.

primary_sources.authority: SAE-authored J995 Revised JUL1999; fastener supplier hosts the primary document
primary_sources.fact: Standard hex UNC proof stresses are 120 ksi for Grade 5 and 150 ksi for Grade 8. Load equals stress times thread tensile area. The axial nut proof test addresses stripping/rupture and post-load removability on its prescribed test bolt or mandrel.
primary_sources.scope: Explicit historical proof envelope; no claim that the complete 1999 and 2017 editions are equivalent. The required conditional purchase specification must meet this stated proof envelope. No complete manual is copied.

primary_sources.locator: Standard hex UNC Grade 5 and Grade 8 proof table and stress-area calculation note
primary_sources.fact: The manufacturer table independently records the same 120/150 ksi standard-hex UNC proof envelopes.

F606/F606M-21 provides proof-load length measurement, full-size axial/wedge tension and nut-proof procedures. Product standards supply properties and applicable tests. Public scope does not authenticate complete test details or delivered performance.
A574 socket-head cap screw requirements include proof and tensile/wedge testing. No material-test result for an actual bolt is inferred.

comparison_scope: Load-only N divided by conditional product proof load. Full standard thread engagement and aligned standard head/nut seating are explicit use conditions. This is not an automatic ASD allowable, combined-wrench resistance, physical conformity, preload allowance or proof-test instruction.
